facts.fact: Actualite.cd reports that the December 2023 contract with Afritech and Idemia, worth $1.2 billion, covered biometric ID cards and a civil registration system, but it was cancelled by mutual consent on 12 August 2024.

facts.fact: Actualite.cd reports that DRC signed a $1.2 billion contract in December 2023 with Afritech and Idemia for biometric ID cards, census operations began in Kinshasa, and the contract was cancelled on 12 August 2024 with ONIP pausing identification, 700 cards having been printed.

COD.note: No local-office digital entry of births or deaths is stated.
